elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both Parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap includes fees paid or payable during the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses “the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the 12-month fees amount and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly sets the cap at the greater of the 12-month fees limb and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Indirect damages are mutually excluded.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect damages, subject to Excluded Claims and legal excludability.

elements.element: Consequential damages are mutually excluded.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for consequential damages, subject to Excluded Claims and legal excludability.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes a Party's breach of confidentiality obligations in Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 excludes all Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of data-protection obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes breach of security obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes indemnification obligations in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes gross negligence in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes fraud in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property in Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 excludes from the cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 states that “Customer's payment obligations” are not damages and are not limited by Section 21.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both Parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap equals 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: Although 12 months' fees form one limb, the operative cap is the greater of that amount and USD 1,000,000; it therefore does not equal 12 months' fees where those fees are below USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and are excluded from the cap under Sections 21.1 and 21.3.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and is excluded from the cap under Sections 21.1 and 21.3.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and is excluded from the cap under Sections 21.1 and 21.3.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and is excluded from the cap under Sections 21.1 and 21.3.

result.reason: The rendered language fully implements the preferred position: it establishes a mutual cap equal to the greater of comprehensive 12-month fees and USD 1,000,000, retains mutual indirect and consequential damages exclusions, preserves all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Customer payment obligations from damages. The edits are targeted to correcting the restricted fee base and broadening the payment-obligation treatment. The fallback is not independently satisfied because its cap is stated as 12 months' fees, whereas the rendered clause imposes a USD 1,000,000 minimum. Drafting quality is strong overall, though “preceding the claim” could be more precisely tied to the date the claim arose or was asserted.
